svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 03 · Davis · 04/12 Farmers Market (Uncommon)
svg.desc: Saturday morning in the park: peaches, peppers, bread, a band, and everyone you know from class. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
